title: [spec-gap][R-LOADNG-001/011-014] LOADng local-evidence gate unwired in all three stacks
description:
Spec appendix-loadng.md intro: 'LOADng is used for mesh-internal peer-to-peer traffic only when recent authenticated evidence indicates that the destination is local. It MUST NOT probe an arbitrary 0200::/8 destination.' B2.2: LOCAL_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME 1200 s; each authenticated Announce/RREP/RPL/DATA observation refreshes evidence for exactly 1200 s, expired at equality; MUST use a monotonic clock and MUST NOT extend evidence after clock regression or timestamp overflow; MUST bound peers retained and MUST NOT silently evict live evidence.

Classification: divergent (gate requirement) + not-implemented (C/Rust evidence tracking).

Evidence: python implements the full gate and passes vectors (python/src/lichen/rpl/evidence.py:14-159; python/src/lichen/rpl/address_classification.py:43-97; tests python/tests/rpl/test_local_evidence_vectors.py:84-94 against test/vectors/local_evidence.json; python/tests/rpl/test_address_classification_vectors.py) but NO production code consults it: python routing initiates discovery on any gradient miss (python/src/lichen/routing/router.py:557-567) and even queues LOADng for EXTERNAL destinations when DODAG is stale (router.py:574-597), contradicting 'mesh-internal p2p only'. C has no evidence code; router.c calls loadng.discover on gradient miss (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c:158-160,244-245,689-702). Rust has no evidence code; hybrid.rs:264-289 queues discovery on gradient miss.

Intra-spec conflict: spec/05-routing.md section 10.2 pseudocode initiates LOADng for any 02xx destination with no gradient (no evidence gate) while appendix-loadng intro mandates the gate (README.md:129-137 supports the gate).

Suggested placement: consult AddressClassificationTable (LOCAL_MESH class) in python Router.route_mesh_local before initiating discovery; implement evidence tracking in rust lichen-node and lichen/subsys/lichen/routing (C); first resolve the 05-routing 10.2 vs appendix-loadng intro conflict in spec text.
